betzaHelp: limited and unlimited distance sliders/riders for W/R, F/B, and N directions
hoppers and grasshoppers for W/R and F/B directions, i.e., pR, pB, gR, and gB
lame leapers (n) for N, A, Z, and D directions, i.e., nN, nA, nZ, and nD

bool.description: boolean flag to enable/disable a feature

Rank.description: denotes a rank of the board

File.description: denotes a file of the board

PieceType.hint: letters defined for pieces, e.g., p

PieceSet.hint: letters defined for pieces, e.g., nbrq

CastlingRights.hint: letters for castling rights as in FEN, e.g., KQkq

Bitboard.description: list of squares [e.g., d4 e4 d5 e5]. * can be used as wildcard for files (e.g., *1 is the first rank)

Value.description: game result for the side to move

CountingRule.description: makruk, cambodian, or ASEAN counting rules

EnclosingRule.hint: reversi, ataxx, quadwrangle, snort, anyside, top, none

WallingRule.hint: arrow, duck, edge, past, static, none
